execution_authority: tasks.json until explicitly migrated to Beads
notes: Task verification commands are proposed interfaces and do not run before implementation. Adjust test paths to the implementation and record actual commands/evidence. M0 gate must pass before T04 or later.

tasks.title: Recheck differentiation and engineering contract
tasks.scope: Read closest prior art and freeze the specific reviewer-testing question; stop or propose contribution if an equivalent exists.
tasks.acceptance: Updated research decision with source/date, bounded novelty statement and first consumer question.
tasks.verification: Read-only primary-source recheck and repository contract inspection (2026-10-04)

tasks.title: Pin the minimal export stack
tasks.scope: Create isolated Python environment; prove CAD/drawing imports; select compatible dependencies and license direction.
tasks.acceptance: A basic STEP/PDF/PNG exports on the initial host and can be inspected; lockfile and license record exist.
tasks.verification: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip check; .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/smoke.py; .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/record_environment.py; actual PNG visual inspection

tasks.title: Build and independently validate one challenge
tasks.scope: Implement the plate triplet and minimal public/private contracts; independent code reimports STEP and reads visible drawing evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Defect, repair and valid alternative verified; forbidden incidental changes rejected.
tasks.verification: .venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/m0.py validate; .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/m0/test_validation.py tests/m0/test_public.py --basetemp evidence/M0/negative-tests -q (15 passed); shipped PNG and independent PDFium crop inspection

tasks.title: Exercise an external reviewer and decide
tasks.scope: Export the neutral public bundle; collect reference and genuine external review paths. The external path must examine the O01 drawing, STEP and manufacturing-stage evidence. Demonstrate a changed result; an injected regression is allowed only with explicit labeling and separately retained external observations.
tasks.acceptance: Raw responses and artifact-localized report; explicit pass/revise/stop for M0. No expansion without pass.
tasks.verification: Isolated reviewer fork_turns=none actual STEP/PDF/PNG/context inspection; reference and raw/adjudicated imports; report; pytest tests/m0 --basetemp evidence/M0/final-tests -q (33 passed,4 upstream warnings); relevant report checks18 passed; tools/replay_m0.py (8 commands); tools/audit_m0.py (34 links)

tasks.title: Version contracts and conclusion semantics
tasks.scope: Define schemas, authority/precedence, explicit coverage/status and migrations; commit fixtures before parallel workers.
tasks.acceptance: Positive/negative contract cases; no hidden premises or unknown-to-pass conversion.

tasks.title: Implement sourced conditional profiles
tasks.scope: Create rule cards and synthetic/profile-specific thresholds, material applicability, finish stage and setup envelope semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Boundary/counterfactual examples and versioned provenance; no universal machinability claims.

tasks.title: Implement three bounded artifact families
tasks.scope: Reuse CAD/drafting backend for supported geometry; generate complete public artifacts and lineage.
tasks.acceptance: Reimport and visual evidence for each family and boundary parameter set.

tasks.title: Implement objective and profile variants
tasks.scope: Implement six objective operators and conditional advisory/profile variants with prerequisites and invariants.
tasks.acceptance: Defect/repair/valid examples; missing context and negative controls; unsupported edits refuse.

tasks.title: Implement independent artifact validator
tasks.scope: Own separate final-artifact readers, analytic checks, mutation-isolation checks and quarantine; coordinate only through public schemas.
tasks.acceptance: Export corruption and collateral defects detected; all scored assertions have independently measured/visible evidence.

tasks.title: Implement reviewer adapters and run lifecycle
tasks.scope: Public-only export, structured import and bounded process protocol; explicit coverage, errors, timeouts and raw-result retention.
tasks.acceptance: External/manual integration; malformed/partial/error results remain observable; no implicit hosted upload.

tasks.title: Implement matching, adjudication and regression
tasks.scope: One-to-one evidence matching, grouped root causes, per-track counts, unresolved findings and compatible-run comparison.
tasks.acceptance: Hand-calculated cases agree; wrong-location/duplicate findings fail correctly; oracle revisions invalidate comparisons.

tasks.title: Build corpus and attack the evaluator
tasks.scope: Curate validated corpus, freeze lineage splits and semantic replay; inject evaluator faults and independently audit controls.
tasks.acceptance: Counts and exclusions recorded; critical mutants caught; blinding and leakage audit; representative rendering reviews.

tasks.title: Build offline report and resilient execution
tasks.scope: Implement escaped source-linked HTML, bounded parsers and recoverable run state.
tasks.acceptance: A reader follows changed finding to exact evidence; unsafe text cannot execute; interruptions preserve results.

tasks.title: Verify independent consumer and transfer
tasks.scope: Clean-install Windows/Linux; external reviewer walkthrough; separately authored case and optional engineer/NIST/second-reader evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Consumer reproduces a useful diagnosis; transfer limits and unavailable human evidence stated explicitly.
tasks.verification: python -m pytest tests/consumer; documented end-to-end demo on both platforms

tasks.title: Finish traceability, docs and article draft
tasks.scope: Review every Must acceptance, record Should deferrals, finalize license/provenance/docs and write evidence-grounded first-person draft.
tasks.acceptance: Complete requirements/evidence matrix, reproducible demo and local unpublished article; no unsupported achievements.
